changelog: Fix: GeoIP must ACCEPT OpenVPN 1194 on WAN (SSH/GUI stay dropped; IKE/WG still peer-locked)
Fix: web filter DoH/QUIC only on LAN→WAN, not tun0 / site-to-site, and do not restart dnsmasq on boot
Fix: DHCP relay to remote AD (VLAN iface, IPSec routes not stolen by WireGuard, dnsmasq must stay up)
Fix: GeoIP on WAN — persist chain, lock SSH/GUI from internet, drop IPv6 WAN, IKE/WG only from site-to-site peer
Fix: VLAN apply no longer wipes dnsmasq relay and AD DNS forwards
